ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_0
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
是啊，那家旅馆很不错～还有人还在睡懒觉，
也有人抓紧最后一刻还在泡温泉

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_1
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
你从小一哭就肯定是自己一个人躲起来。
躲在窗帘后面，蜷着小小的背

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_2
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
你能遇到这么棒的Family。
有了可以和你一起分担这份难过的人

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_3
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
『其实，铃木直接给我打了电话。
说想谈关于Live House的生意』

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_4
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
『我从蕾叶那儿听说了，所以我也拒绝了这件事。
让蕾叶坚持自己决定的事，是家长的责任啊』

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_5
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
『你那天死活要睡帐篷，搞得我们慌慌张张
跑去买那种不用打地钉的帐篷，这你都忘了？』

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_6
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
『作为Family的前辈……作为蕾叶的家长，
我会全力支持你的决定』

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_7
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
就算是为了夺回Family，
你也不能去把别人家的演出搅得一团糟啊！！

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_8
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
哎呀，你们几位就是蕾叶的Family吧。
平时多谢你们照顾我们家蕾叶啦～

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_9
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
……不过呢，铃木小姐您对几个孩子也没少下狠手，
就当我们扯平了吧

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_10
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
蕾叶，你身边有你的Family，也有我们这些奶奶。
这件事你可不能忘了哦

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_11
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
那，你回你的Family那边去吧。
送到这里就可以了

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_12
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
哎呀，看到你们笑得这么开心，
下一趟旅行我也能放心出发了

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_13
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
大家都攒了一肚子话要说。
那就开饭吧！两边的Family见个面！！

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_14
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
——所以，这事儿就翻篇了。
不管你怎么联系我，我都不会让步的

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_15
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
『至今都让你按自己的想法去做了……
你已经很努力了』

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_16
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
咦，我还以为你会更羡慕的。
会像以前那样喊着『我也好想去啊～！』

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_17
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
『Live House的事现在不用担心。
交给奶奶就好』

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_18
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
『……能说出这样的话，
看来你遇到了很好的Family啊，蕾叶』

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_19
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
『蕾叶你就专心处理自己Family的事吧。
还没完全解决对吧？』

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_20
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
哦，你就是传说中的心玖啊！！
听说你面对大人非但没怂，反倒把人家给威胁了～？

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_21
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
铃木那家伙跟我抱怨说
『简直跟被威胁了一样』

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_22
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
是我对孙女的管教不周，
给您添了这么大麻烦，非常抱歉

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_23
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
『哦，蕾叶的Family也在一起吗？
让我见见你们吧！』

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_24
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
『啊哈哈！
跟听说的一样，是群有活力的Family，多好啊！』

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_25
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
『好～包在我身上！
哎呀～好久没回日本了，还真挺期待的！』

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_26
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
『啊？哦……
那还不是因为蕾叶你大哭大闹说非要去露营嘛』

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_27
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text: 喂！！别让我宝贝孙女背你这么沉的家伙！

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_28
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
哦～回来啦！
今天在学校也开心吗？

ws_voice_1_0#2.Name: voice_29
ws_voice_1_0#2.Text:
正要准备呢。
好了，都动起来，动作快点！

ws_voice_1_1#2.PostCommand: lip_sync enable; start_mtn ournotes_l2d_carrier_sub_raikas_grandmother ws_voice_finished_1#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.Text:
铃木那家伙跟我抱怨说
『简直跟被威胁了一样』

ws_voice_1_1#2.Name: voice_22
ws_voice_1_1#2.PostCommand: lip_sync enable; start_mtn ournotes_l2d_carrier_sub_raikas_grandmother ws_voice_finished_1#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.Text:
是我对孙女的管教不周，
给您添了这么大麻烦，非常抱歉

ws_voice_1_1#2.Name: voice_23
ws_voice_1_1#2.PostCommand: lip_sync enable; start_mtn ournotes_l2d_carrier_sub_raikas_grandmother ws_voice_finished_1#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.Text:
『哦，蕾叶的Family也在一起吗？
让我见见你们吧！』

ws_voice_1_1#2.Name: voice_24
ws_voice_1_1#2.PostCommand: lip_sync enable; start_mtn ournotes_l2d_carrier_sub_raikas_grandmother ws_voice_finished_1#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.Text:
『啊哈哈！
跟听说的一样，是群有活力的Family，多好啊！』

ws_voice_1_1#2.Name: voice_25
ws_voice_1_1#2.PostCommand: lip_sync enable; start_mtn ournotes_l2d_carrier_sub_raikas_grandmother ws_voice_finished_1#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.Text:
『好～包在我身上！
哎呀～好久没回日本了，还真挺期待的！』

ws_voice_1_1#2.Name: voice_26
ws_voice_1_1#2.PostCommand: lip_sync enable; start_mtn ournotes_l2d_carrier_sub_raikas_grandmother ws_voice_finished_1#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.Text:
『啊？哦……
那还不是因为蕾叶你大哭大闹说非要去露营嘛』

ws_voice_1_1#2.Name: voice_27
ws_voice_1_1#2.PostCommand: lip_sync enable; start_mtn ournotes_l2d_carrier_sub_raikas_grandmother ws_voice_finished_1#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.Text: 喂！！别让我宝贝孙女背你这么沉的家伙！

ws_voice_1_1#2.Name: voice_28
ws_voice_1_1#2.PostCommand: lip_sync enable; start_mtn ournotes_l2d_carrier_sub_raikas_grandmother ws_voice_finished_1#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.Text:
哦～回来啦！
今天在学校也开心吗？

ws_voice_1_1#2.Name: voice_29
ws_voice_1_1#2.PostCommand: lip_sync enable; start_mtn ournotes_l2d_carrier_sub_raikas_grandmother ws_voice_finished_1#9; start_mtn ws_voice_gap#7
ws_voice_1_1#2.Text:
正要准备呢。
好了，都动起来，动作快点！
